summary: issue-516-mlua-adapter: binding-fit investigation for swapping interim synvelis-script-luau(mlua) onto ruviform_script_luau::LuauBackend (synvelis#516)

E1: direct crate swap is impossible — trait signatures (open_session by-ref vs by-value, evaluate() vs evaluate(Option<&str>)), error enum payloads, SessionConfig fields (host_bindings/placement_hint/resume), digest format (sha256: vs sha256:v1:), and artifact payload shape (ScriptValue vs Record-only BTreeMap) all differ across the neutral boundary.

E1 verdict: adopt thin anti-corruption binding — keep the synvelis port surface and delegate runtime to the product backend. Rejected: (a) permanent interim adoption (duplicates product implementation), (b) re-binding port vocabulary to ruviform types (breaks consumers + keeps duplication).

E2: Cargo.lock moved all ruviform git deps cbcc8343 -> 84a68f25. Verified old pin predates ruviform-script-luau entirely (runtime backend dce45712/PR #729); the rev bump is required, not accidental — cargo unifies the git source revision across the workspace.

E3: two backend tests failed after the swap — scripts returning non-record values while an artifact kind is requested now hit the product contract's Record-required payload rule (Internal) where the interim accepted any ScriptValue. Product contract is stricter; adapter does not loosen it. Tests updated to record-shaped payloads; bare scalar -> Internal is now verified.

E4: neutral ScriptErrorKind::BudgetExceeded carries no dimension. Decision: widen port to Option<BudgetKind>; adapter reports Some(kind) only when exactly one enforceable budget dimension was armed, None otherwise — never guess. Consumers do not destructure kind, so the port change is non-breaking.

E5: clippy fixes — extracted product_artifact_kinds helper (open_session too_many_lines 101/100), merged duplicate match arms (Internal/future kinds -> wildcard, diagnostic severity Info|Hint/Warning/wildcard).

All experiments resolved: thin binding adopted and implemented; 30 real-VM tests pass; synvelis-automation/cli regression green; check-headless-deps and prek pass; mlua remains transitively isolated inside ruviform-script-luau.
